name: Adomik Jean Pierre
description:
Adomik unifies fragmented advertising data and powers specialized AI agents that help teams understand and benchmark performance, make better decisions, and move faster across their workflows.

Jean Pierre (JP) is an advanced AI platform purpose-built for advertising professionals. JP understands your data, compares to the market, answers your questions, and helps you take action—wherever you work:

UNDERSTAND
JP analyzes your advertising data across sources in real time, identifying patterns and anomalies, benchmarking performance against the market, and surfacing opportunities.

PREPARE
Turn raw data into business-ready deliverables in minutes, from executive summaries to wrap-up decks.

OPTIMIZE
Receive actionable recommendations for optimization, backed by data and industry best practices.

EXECUTE
Let JP execute tasks on your behalf, from generating reports and forecasts to implementing optimization strategies

_published_faq.name: How do I add Adomik Jean Pierre to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Adomik Jean Pierre to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.adomik.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Adomik Jean Pierre MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Adomik Jean Pierre lists 13 MCP tools, including client_meeting_prep, confluence_get_page, confluence_get_page_children, confluence_search, jp_demand_pulse, jp_market_analyst, jp_news_watch, jp_rev_analyst, jp_revenue_drivers, jp_verified_buyer_mapping_analyst, market_comparison, and market_comparison_us_news.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Adomik Jean Pierre?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Adomik Jean Pierre in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.

_published_faq.name: Does Adomik Jean Pierre MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Adomik Jean Pierre requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Adomik Jean Pierre is developed by Adomik. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
